digest.component_or_area: completion verifier evidence banking and tri-state verdict determination
propositions: At search exhaustion the verifier incorrectly banks `met=false` (refutation) for unexamined criteria when budget is exhausted before evidence is found, causing false FAIL verdicts on tickets whose evidence exists but was unreached

The framework must distinguish three evidence outcomes—met, refuted, insufficient—and carry insufficient-evidence state as an optional `evidence_sufficient:false` marker alongside `met=false` to prevent false negatives

Banked entries must preserve the marker through harvest overwrites so that a genuine refutation (bare `met=false` from the model) replaces but does not erase insufficiency, while model tools remain bool-only

All consumers of verdict data—renderers, close gates, finalizer merge, sidecar payload—must emit and report `evidence_sufficient:false` as exhaustion (prompting re-verify) not refutation, and must block completion identically (fail-closed semantics unchanged)
